reason: Complete EN and KO manuscript reading and internally supported notation/narrative/source-fidelity audit finished.
coverage:
ROLE: Prior-context manuscript/source-fidelity review, not a source-naive fresh-reader test. Intended reader: mathematically literate owner seeking a complete experiment explanation. Current-pass evidence: only the two complete pinned HTML manuscripts and the supplied reader contract; no new source verification in this pass.
SOURCE-SPAN MAP (both languages read in order): opening/title gives paired-arm claim and provisional status; #results states coordinator-facing consumers and assumptions; #pnt states locked PNT formulas and proof-level tradeoffs; #frontier compares quantities and domains; #reuse explains typed-input, signed-deficit and source-linked-output mechanisms; #mertens-proof derives the positive bias; #ramanujan separates mathematical assembly from missing source-first coverage; #structure defines network objects; #experiment records treatment, timing, isolation, helper defect and resources; #trust separates proof levels; #historical gives later QRH functions; #sources records printed-proof findings and negative attempts; #reproduce describes artifacts, remaining tasks and publication identity. All headings, tables, displays, citation labels and endings were read. MathML markup was inspected to avoid mistaking extraction loss of radicals/fractions for manuscript errors.
NOTATION/TERM REGISTER: π,G,RG,A,E,L,v,B5,A*,u,J,Eψ,Eπ are introduced; li/Li₂ are delayed; ψ,θ lack an explicit function key; NL mapping is implicit; QRH is unstated; cap10.3194/11.1404 lack a sum/range; c,d deficits lack their exact normalization; F/H are local Ramanujan losses while F(B,L),R,W,Bvector/Bmass are later historical functions; “primorial margin1.876” remains unspecified; consumer/contract/source predicate/bridge are defined late. PV is eventually explicitly reserved for source-first verification and is not treated as kernel arithmetic.
CITATION REGISTER: literature badges identify Büthe, Büthe2016, Dudek–Platt, Johnston, DLMF, BFKNW, CH and Lee–Nosal. Their roles are retained source inputs, baseline formulas and comparison context. This pass did not re-open them or certify their statements. New theorem/ledger/replay evidence is referred to but not linked from the manuscript. Reader findings rely on manuscript wording, not fresh external claims.
ORIGINAL OUTLINE: O1 state paired experiment; O2 present completed consumers; O3 compare locked PNT proposals; O4 present whole-family frontier table; O5 explain reuse mechanisms; O6 derive Mertens corollary; O7 delimit source-first finite gap; O8 define network packaging; O9 explain design/timing/resources; O10 classify proof levels; O11 explain historical comparison; O12 list source issues/failures; O13 reproduce and continue.
SIMPLIFIED OUTLINE: S1 define treatments, key functions and stage/credit vocabulary [O1 plus compact reminders fromO8/O9/O10]; S2 show locked arm results and compatible function comparisons [O3/O4/O11]; S3 separately show coordinator-completed consumers and their actual input/consumer paths [O2/O5/O6]; S4 state exact remaining source-first and analytic gaps [O7/O10]; S5 retain detailed design, limitations, source findings, evidence links and next actions [O8/O9/O12/O13]. This is an editorial map, not a new proof or required wholesale rewrite.
OUTLINE CHANGES: only move a short terminology/treatment key earlier, separate mixed-stage table rows, and connect the existing finite/tail guarantees. Repeated proof-boundary reminders were reviewed; most are useful in their distinct contexts, so no blanket deletion is recommended. The proposed glossary and evidence table can shorten repeated opaque labels without removing necessary qualifications.
limitations: The reviewer has substantial prior mathematical/source context from earlier final-NL review; this is not an independently source-naive reading.
Only the current manuscripts and supplied reader contract were used as new evidence. No theorem-correctness verdict or new source comparison is issued here.
Both HTML inputs place the content on original line2, so locations use real section ids plus exact original quotations; generated text line numbers are not used as source coordinates.
The already-planned final-NL mathematical integrations are listed separately below and are not counted as reader defects.
No manuscript was edited by this reviewer.
